name: Devourer of Souls
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The time has come for you to learn more of the summoning magics. You will learn to summon a succubus, a creature of incredible mental powers. It can lull those of weak minds into its servitude--but have no fear! I feel certain that you will be equal to the challenge.

A succubus can only be summoned when baited with an item that represents great devotion and love. I leave it to you to find such an object.

A suggestion? Speak with Cazul... There seems to be little the ancient warlock does not know.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Cazul in the Cleft of Shadow.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Hm... adventurer. You are still new to your path, but I sense the possibility for greatness in you.

You were born with gifts, adventurer. See that they do not go to waste.

quests.name: Love's Gift

quests.name: The Binding
quests.objectiveText: Using Dogran's Pendant, summon and subdue a succubus, then return Dogran's Pendant to Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar.
